decisions.reason: The firm launched a multi-model LHD loader line only a year ago and presents it publicly as core to its underground mining direction, so the heavy engineering investment and visible commitment favor persistence while any weak early results can still be blamed on start-up conditions.

The underground dump truck line is a recent, multi-model, publicly shown investment that complements the loader offering, so writing it off after one year would expose the launch decision as a mistake, and early shortfalls are still easily attributed to temporary market-entry causes.
